messages:
Ravi: Hi team, new hire here. My headset and USB-C power cable were missing from the kit (order tag RJ-NEWHIRE). I only got laptop, dock, and monitor stands. Who do I ping to get the missing peripherals shipped? Also my external keyboard is showing UK layout even though I selected US.

jordan_it: Welcome Ravi! Sorry about that. Can you DM a pic of the kit contents and the packing slip number? For the keyboard layout, try System Settings > Keyboard > Input Sources and remove the UK layout, then add US.

Ravi: Sent images and packing slip in DM. Did the keyboard change but mac still autocorrects to £ symbol on alt+4 sometimes.

it-bot: New IT ticket #45088 created  "Missing headset & power cable; keyboard layout odd" assigned to jordan_it.

jordan_it: Got the DM. I escalated to facilities for a re-pick/shipment. For the £ symbol: double-check the physical keyboard label and try toggling the modifier mapping in Karabiner if you still see wrong keycodes.

sophia-facilities: Hi @jordan_it and @Ravi, we can ship a spare headset (Wireless Pro) and a 90W USB-C brick today via priority if you confirm your address. We will include a return label for the incomplete kit. ETA 2 business days. If you're SF office local we can do same-day front desk pickup.

Ravi: I'm remote (Seattle). Please ship to 123 Rainier Ave S, Apt 4. Thanks for the quick response.

jordan_it: Shipping scheduled. Also, keep the keyboard connected and run `hidutil property --get \"KeyboardMapping\"` and paste output if issue persists, we'll remote in to debug.

Ravi: Will try Karabiner and send the hidutil output if needed. Appreciate the fast help :smile:
